szoveg_eredeti:
Try App Studio: https://app.runway.com

Learn how to build your first app in Runway App Studio. Describe the creative tool you wish existed in plain language and App Studio handles the coding, testing and hosting. We cover building your app, refining it, publishing and sharing it with your team — so a workflow you repeat on every project becomes an app you build once and run whenever you need it.

App Studio is available today on every paid Runway plan.
